summary: Rings of Air, Water and Earth rewired to their Emperor Edition scans: Air recruits after a third Spell/Kiho action of different titles in a turn and straightens a performing Personality's unit; Water recruits after a fourth Battle action of different titles in a battle and moves a performing Personality home or to an enemy battlefield, straightening his unit if he moved; Earth also needs none of the winner's Personalities destroyed. Added Kiho/non-Kiho counting regressions for Air and the Void.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client (results recorded in the PR)
remaining: Favor-action and Terrain-played/destroyed counters are still recorded but no longer read by any Ring; Void/Air counting grants for the next/current battle like the other Rings.
